decisions.decision: Use betting-win-surebet117.zip as the exact documentation preimage while classifying all three BWS116 reviews as COMPATIBLE_AND_UNAFFECTED_BY_DELTA because every member path, byte, size, and mode is identical.
Retain all 41 confirmed finding IDs unchanged. No confirmed findings are merged because no pair shares the same trigger, root cause, and minimal correction boundary.
Consolidate BWS116-R01-HO-002 and both KNOWN_BASELINE_MANIFEST_DRIFT records under canonical non-defect handoff ID KNOWN_BASELINE_MANIFEST_DRIFT with R11 ownership.
R01 owns immutable upstream cycle identity, provenance, and exact consumed-record semantics. R03 owns the atomic persistence and checkpoint mechanics required to store that cycle.

R02 owns complete-set, provider/generation, quote, fee, capacity, and solver semantics after intake. R01 remains owner of upstream authority and currentness before records cross into the strategy layer.
R01 pagination/HTTP deadlines, R03 psql command deadlines, and R03 service cancellation are related dependencies but distinct root causes and must not be merged.

Retain BWS116-R03-001 as P0. Current supplied migrations are presently surebet-qualified; the defect is the callable migration source/scope authority that accepts external and cross-schema executable SQL.
Current task/status and BWS-600/BWS-710/BWS-900 routing documents remain untouched. Review documentation is subordinate and cannot promote readiness.
Node 22 observations remain supplementary. Any implementation acceptance must rerun the relevant suite under exact Node 20.20.2.

R03 PostgreSQL findings supported only statically remain confirmed source defects where the code path is direct, but PostgreSQL isolation, crash, and role enforcement acceptance remains unproven until a disposable database run.
Do not integrate or modify betting-win. Prior BW R13/R17/R18 material and its failed documentation overlay remain out of scope and process-only evidence.

The exact archive and validate_source_manifest.py result override the stale PROJECT_STATUS prose claiming the previous manifest diagnostic was resolved. The review overlay records the contradiction but does not rewrite protected status; R11 owns correction.
Wave 02 R04-R06 may proceed in parallel as read-only research. No source implementation starts before all review outputs are consolidated and dependency-ready fix tranches are approved.
Use betting-win-surebet118.zip as the exact Wave 02 documentation preimage. Its 657 paths and bytes match all three review coverage manifests.
Classify the Wave 01 R01-R03 overlay as LANDED_IN_CURRENT_REPOSITORY because every one of its 40 postimages is present in BWS118 and exactly equals the supplied overlay package.
Retain all 44 new R04-R06 finding IDs. No new finding shares both root cause and minimal correction boundary with an inherited or concurrent finding.
R04 owns simulation event identity and lifecycle representation; R03 owns durable atomic create-or-compare and crash recovery. Related manifestations are dependencies, not duplicates.
R02 owns planned quote/fee/solver economics; R04 owns actual-fill terms, residual exposure, settlement, correction, finality, and falsification semantics.
R04 owns lifecycle truth before projection. R05 owns preservation of that truth in API contracts and cockpit presentation.
R01 owns upstream pagination/receipt identity. R05 owns BWS-local API cursor, query-scope, snapshot, and continuation semantics.
R03 owns repository failures and durable transitions. R05 owns public error taxonomy, sanitization, and empty-versus-failed projection.
R05 owns browser request-generation and stale-state behavior. R06 owns process, listener, and service lifecycle cancellation.
R03 job leases and R06 process ownership are independent authority layers and require separate fencing primitives.
R06 owns health/readiness source truth and CLI/systemd exit semantics; R05 owns faithful display of those typed states.
R06 aggregate lifecycle deadlines do not replace R01 HTTP-cycle deadlines or R03 psql/job cancellation. Each remains separately owned.
R06 lifecycle evidence filename uniqueness is a source defect. R07 and R12 may consume it as a publication/controller dependency but must not duplicate it.
Node 22 observations remain supplementary. Canonical implementation acceptance requires Node 20.20.2.
Preserve KNOWN_BASELINE_MANIFEST_DRIFT under R11. Do not regenerate SOURCE_MANIFEST.json in a documentation-only overlay.
Current BWS-600, BWS-710, BWS-900, controller, deployment, and runtime authority documents remain byte-identical. Review evidence cannot promote them.
Wave 03 R07-R09 may proceed in parallel as read-only research. No application implementation is authorized before the complete review program is consolidated.
